title: Samnay Laila Day Kuj Dair To Bay Akbar
body:
Main Tarasgaiyan Kadhi Maa Aakay (x2)
Ik Vaar To Keh Akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
Abbas Gawah Hay Mera, Nahi Naam Lawangi Tera (x2)
Menu Akbar Nay Maa Keha Hay (x2)
Mera Waada Hay Akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
Har Saal Banoundi Raiyan, Sochan Ch Sajandi Raiyan (x2)
O Saal Atharan Day Cholay (x2)
Tu Vekh Lavin Akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
Sughara Nu Dekay Vichora Gal Paalea Maut Da Jora (x2)
O Khairi Wapis Nahi Aaye (x2)
Jere Maqtal Gaye Akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
Marjavin Maa Na Javin Na Pyu Nu Maar Mukavin (x2)
Tere Bajon Sadhay Khol Kohi (x2)
Nahio Rehni Sheh Akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
Abbas Da Ay Ehsan Ay, Aj Akbar Mera Mehmaan Ay (x2)
Zainab Ton Laila Day Tain (x2)
Kita Fasila Tay Akbar (x2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Rab Adal Jaanay Da Haal Ay Akbar Ik Wakhra Laal Ay (x2)
Maawan Nu Bachray Nahi Labnay (x2)
Haye Tere Jaye Akbar
